name: Adobe Analytics
description: Adobe Analytics is an enterprise digital-experience analytics platform that brings together website, mobile, and product interaction data into a single source of truth, connecting customer journeys across channels.
best_for: Marketing and business leaders at large enterprises who need data-driven decision making across web, mobile, and product analytics, with governance and compliance aligned to Adobe Experience Platform.
features: Analysis Workspace: a drag-and-drop interface for building and sharing analyses and visualizations
Real-time data analysis with advanced segmentation
Predictive analytics and cross-channel marketing attribution
Product Analytics for feature and journey usage in digital products
Content Analytics for asset-level performance and creative attributes
Role-based dashboards and a mobile scorecard app
Bulk and streaming APIs, data feeds, and warehouse exports to Azure, Amazon S3, Google BigQuery, and Snowflake

alternatives.name: Google Analytics
alternatives.description: A free analytics tool from Google measuring customer behavior across websites and apps.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses of every size wanting free, easy measurement unified with Google's ad platforms.

alternatives.name: Amplitude
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform combining analytics, feedback, experimentation, and feature management.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams needing analytics with feature experimentation.

alternatives.name: Mixpanel
alternatives.description: A product intelligence platform combining analytics, session replay, experiments, and AI-powered insights.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams wanting fast, data-driven product decisions.
